metadataRaw.title: 3 Exercises You Need to Do After 40
metadataRaw.description:
If you're over 40 and starting to notice new aches and pains, this video is a must-watch.

Dr. Rowe demonstrates three exercises that help keep your back and hips strong, mobile, and pain-free, improving your quality of life as you age.

These exercises target the key muscles that contribute to lower back and hip pain. Each one works differently, and when combined, they provide a well-rounded workout you can do daily or 2-3 times a week.
